tools.description: Get one listing by opaque id, including how_to and the signed payload.

tools.name: register_publisher
tools.description: Register an Ed25519 public key. Returns an api_key shown once. payload must be a JSON string you signed.

tools.name: publish_app
tools.description: List an app. Auto-publishes. Requires api_key plus signature of the payload string.

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Replace a listing you own. Same signing rules as publish_app.
